archive.note: 5.23 GB total - exceeds the 50 MB cap, so only member files were sampled; the per-file sha256 values come from the Mendeley public API and all six downloads matched byte for byte

arrays.t2.nii.gz: dim=(330,384,128), 16220160 voxels, T2-weighted anatomical volume used for the pial PVS area measurement

subjects.n: UNKNOWN from the sampled files (per-animal counts are in the unsampled 4D DCE volumes)

units_verified_C3.verdict: UNIT METADATA DEFECT - the header declares metres but the values are millimetres (80/80/110 um and 91/91/156 um, consistent with the paper's stated 220 um slices with 110 um overlap and a 375x250 matrix over 30x20 mm). Trusting the header gives a 1000x length error and a 10^6 x volume error.

units_readable_from_repository_code.calculate_pvs_csa.m: pvs_volume = sum(partial_volume)*prod(pixdim) [mm^3]; pvs_csa = pvs_volume/pvs_length [mm^2]; max_length in mm; partial volume dimensionless
units_readable_from_repository_code.dce_mri_calc_concentration.py: T1 map read as milliseconds then multiplied by 1e-3 -> seconds; TR likewise converted to seconds; flip angle in degrees; Gd_conc = invT1c / Gd_calib, Gd_calib default 2.69, README states 1.398 for this data set (Gd relaxivity per unit concentration)
units_readable_from_repository_code.implied_concentration_unit: mmol/L, numerically identical to mol/m3, which matches the model's concentration unit exactly

units_verified_C3.temporal_resolution: T1 map frame time and TR are script arguments, not stored in the sampled files; the record states DCE frame rate 4 min 5 s with 3 baseline + 42 post-infusion frames, i.e. 45 time points over about 3.1 h
units_verified_C3.units_status: ESTABLISHED from repository code and record text, but NOT from the sampled image headers (which are wrong); the 45-frame series itself was not downloaded because each dce.nii.gz is 201-216 MB

coordinate_frame_C3.verdict: NIfTI-RAS nominal (sform_code 1) with the x axis flipped, as expected for a Bruker/Paravision V4 export; template and anatomy share the same grid, so they are co-registered. t2.nii.gz carries an invalid qform_code (-31288) and must be read through sform only.

constrains_Q156.quantity: pial perivascular-space cross-sectional area [mm^2] measured on T2, and CSF-to-brain tracer concentration time series [mmol/L] after cisterna-magna Gd-DTPA (0.5 kDa) infusion
model_parameters: eps_pvs (via CSA and the paper's vessel-surface normalisation)
D_isf (parenchymal spread of a 0.5 kDa tracer, i.e. a size-matched partner to the model's 3 kD D_isf)
constrains_Q156.value_class: SOURCE for geometry and units; the numeric CSA and inflow values are in the paper, not in the sampled files, so no number is claimed here

C1_coverage_3_measured_sources.detail: S1 and S2 are verified measured sources. Only 2 of 3 were achieved; the shortfall is reported, not padded.

C1a_at_least_one_diffusivity_or_porosity.which: S2 (pial PVS cross-sectional area, i.e. eps_pvs)

C1b_at_least_one_time_resolved.which: S2 provides a 45-frame tracer series in the repository (3 baseline + 42 post-infusion frames at 4 min 5 s) but every series file is 201-216 MB and therefore outside the 50 MB cap, so no time-resolved payload was actually verified; S1 is explicitly not time-resolved

C2_form_check.detail: 6/6 NIfTI-1 headers parsed from Dryad S1 and 3/3 NIfTI-1 headers from Mendeley S2, magic and sizeof_hdr correct in every case

C3_unit_frame_check.detail: every stored file received an explicit unit and frame verdict; two real defects found (S1 declares no units at all, S2 declares metres for millimetre voxels) and one invalid field (S2 t2.nii.gz qform_code = -31288)

C5_artifact_typing.detail: X1 code, X2 figure, X3 simulation, X4 unknown - none counted toward C1

C6_no_invention.detail: no numeric measurement is claimed for S1 or S2; the only numbers are file sizes, sha256 sums, header fields, voxel value ranges, and label sets, all of which are in this JSON

control_1_placebo_irrelevant_dataset.finding: S1 is a glymphatic-targeted dataset yet all five record-level fields are fillable, while it yields no usable number without the paper's b-values. Field-completeness therefore did not track usefulness. The literal musculoskeletal-GRF placebo archive was not fetched inside the time budget.

control_2_inherited_artifact_audit.finding: Of the three artifacts inherited from the interrupted session, one is a measured dataset (S1, Dryad 121hs31) and two are not (X1 code, X2 figure). The interrupted session had therefore not yet produced a single verified measured sample, and the second half of the task was not started.

control_3_unit_trap.finding: S2's NIfTI headers declare spatial unit = metre while pixdim are millimetres; S1 declares no unit and carries an all-ones pixdim placeholder. Both would silently corrupt eps_pvs and L if trusted. This is the single most consequential result of the audit.

bottom_line.eps_isf_0p20: still unconstrained by any downloaded public measurement
bottom_line.D_isf_1e-10_for_3kD: still unconstrained - the closest is S2's 0.5 kDa Gd-DTPA parenchymal spread, whose numeric value lives in the paper, not in the files
bottom_line.L_250um: no public vessel-spacing measurement was retrieved; S2's 80-156 um voxel grid is an imaging limit, not a spacing measurement
bottom_line.t50_600s: no downloaded dataset can test the 600 s half-filling criterion; S2's hourly frame rate is 36x too coarse for a 600 s target
bottom_line.recommendation: the Q156 next step is still not data-feasible as a held-out sub-10-minute test. A workable version is a two-tier test: seconds-to-minutes geometry and exchange from S2 at its native 4 min 5 s cadence, and hours-to-days clearance from a CSF/ISF tracer series. The 600 s criterion itself has to be sourced from an animal two-photon or fibre-optic tracer series with known geometry, which no public archive located here provides.
